# Wahlblick

> Wahlblick (wahlblick.de) is an independent, free, interactive map of German election results by federal state (Bundesland): the Bundestag (federal) election and the most recent election in each of the 16 state parliaments (Landtage), with historical results. The whole site is available in German, Spanish and English.

## Main

- [Interactive election map](https://wahlblick.de/): results by Bundesland for the Bundestag and the Landtage, with year selection, side-by-side comparison of states and a single-party view.
- [Electoral system / Wahlsystem](https://wahlblick.de/sitzverteilung.html): how the Bundestag's 630 seats are allocated (Sainte-Laguë method), with an interactive seat-distribution simulator.
- [Parties / Parteien](https://wahlblick.de/parties.html): profiles of Germany's political parties.
- [Coalitions / Koalitionen](https://wahlblick.de/government.html): coalition types and how a government is formed.

## Germany

- [Basic Law / Grundgesetz](https://wahlblick.de/grundgesetz.html): Germany's constitution.
- [Address directory / Adressverzeichnis](https://wahlblick.de/directory.html): useful official addresses and services, aimed especially at the Spanish-speaking community.
- [Public holidays / Feiertage](https://wahlblick.de/holidays.html): public holidays in Germany.

## About

- [About Wahlblick / Über uns](https://wahlblick.de/about.html): the project, its methodology and its data sources.
- [User guide / Nutzungshinweise](https://wahlblick.de/guide.html): how to use the site.
